transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well, Dr. Smith, I came in 'cause my family and friends kinda forced it. They keep shoving these bank papers in my face, saying they prove nothing was taken from me. But I ain't dumb. For over a year now, I’ve known they’re hiding my money. They keep coming up with all these fake bills and church fundraisers and trip plans just to cover it all up, so I have to keep confronting them until they finally tell the truth. 

Speaking of those trip plans, they were talking about going down to the beach, but the sand there always gets everywhere and ruins everything. I went to the beach when I was a little girl and I stepped on a jellyfish. It stung real bad, and my uncle told me you're supposed to pee on it to make it stop hurting, which is just nasty if you think about it. I mean, who even comes up with that? Probably the same people who invent those weird infomercials on TV late at night. I bought a blender from one of those once, but the blade got stuck on a piece of ice the very first time I used it, and I couldn't get it unstuck no matter how hard I pulled...
Aside from what you've told me about your family, do you ever hear voices or see things that other people around you don't seem to notice?

Hear voices? No, I don't hear no voices or see ghosts or nothing like that. My ears and eyes work just fine. 

I actually got my eyes checked at that Walmart vision center a while back. The doctor there, he had this real bright light he kept shining right in my face, gave me a terrible headache. I get headaches sometimes if I drink too much soda, especially the dark kind like cola. I prefer ginger ale. It settles your stomach better. I had the stomach flu last Thanksgiving and couldn't even eat the turkey. Which was a real shame 'cause my aunt makes a really good turkey, she puts apples and onions inside it instead of just that dry bread stuff. I tried to make a turkey myself once, but I accidentally left that little plastic bag of guts inside the bird while it was in the oven. It smelled like burning tires in the whole house for a week. We had to keep all the windows open, and the neighbor's orange cat kept trying to climb in through the screen... he’s a fat cat, too, so he actually ripped a hole in the mesh. I tried to patch it up with duct tape, but duct tape gets all gooey when the sun hits it, you know?
